products.name: Noir Midnight Blossom Embroidered Tulle Gown
products.description: An exquisite obsidian evening gown featuring a sculpted sweetheart corset bodice enriched with intricate 3D floral appliqués, vine-inspired jet beadwork, and subtle tonal shimmering accents. The floral embellishments gently cascade down past the cinched waistline onto a fluid, floor-sweeping layered French tulle and chiffon skirt with soft structural pleating.

products.name: Petal Blossom Embroidered Tulle Gown
products.description: An ethereal haute-couture floor-length ballgown with hand-embroidered 3D floral appliqués and vine beadwork on a sweetheart corset bodice, flowing into pleated rose chiffon layers.
products.material: French Tulle, Silk Crepe, Hand-sewn 3D Blossoms

products.name: Rose Blossom Silk Evening Gown
products.description: A breathtaking floor-length couture evening gown crafted from 100% pure Mulberry silk. Features a sculpted corset bodice with sweetheart neckline and flowing organza cascading hemline. Inspired by morning Parisian rose gardens.

products.name: Whispering Peony Chiffon Dress
products.description: Airy, whimsical pleated dress featuring hand-pressed accordion pleats and a flattering defined waist. Perfect for cocktail receptions, garden parties, and celebratory soirees.
products.material: Fine Italian Silk Chiffon with Satin Lining

products.name: Lavender Mist Satin Slip Gown
products.description: Minimalist 90s-inspired liquid satin slip dress in an ethereal soft lavender blush tone. Bias-cut silhouette drapes effortlessly against the body with a delicate cowl neckline and lace-up back.

products.name: Champagne Elegance Tiered Gown
products.description: An architectural bridal and gala masterpiece. Layered cascading tiers of delicate French tulle over a corset bodice embellished with subtle pearl and metallic shimmer threading.
products.material: French Tulle, Silk Crepe, Hand-beaded Crystals

products.name: Blush Dahlia Corset Maxi
products.description: Romantic floor-grazing maxi dress with a structured boned corset, draped off-the-shoulder straps, and a sweeping side leg opening. A customer favorite for galas and red-carpet moments.
products.material: Double-faced Silk Crepe with Soft Spandex Blend

products.name: Aurora Rose Halter Cocktail Dress
products.description: Sensational halter-neck mini-to-midi cocktail dress with high-gloss sheen and a sculptural crossover neckline. Tailored for unforgettable nights out.
products.material: Heavy Silk Satin with stretch comfort lining

products.name: Orchid Breeze Tulle Ballgown
products.description: Fairytale couture ballgown rendered in softest lilac-pink tones. Featuring three-dimensional embroidered floral blossoms hand-sewn across the bodice and drifting down the voluminous skirt.
products.material: Embroidered French Tulle, Silk Organza, Pearl Accents

products.name: Silk Blossom Minimalist Slip
products.description: Effortless luxury daywear. Breathable washed mulberry silk slip that effortlessly transitions from afternoon gallery strolls to sunset rooftop cocktails.

products.name: Starlight Shimmer Mermaid Gown
products.description: Show-stopping figure-hugging silhouette hugging every contour before flaring into a theatrical floor-sweeping mermaid train. Woven with micro-reflector pink crystals.

products.name: Sunlit Peaches Summer Sundress
products.description: Breezy linen-cotton blend sundress with tie-up shoulder ribbons and a fitted smocked back. Soft peach blush tones evoke sun-drenched Mediterranean holidays.
